# ankra_ai_remediation_policy (Data Source)

Reads the organisation's AI remediation policy: whether Ankra AI may act on incidents, how much on its own, and within which limits. An organisation that never set one reads as the platform default (disabled, `propose`). The policy is changed in the portal by an organisation admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_ai_remediation_policy" "this" {}

output "ai_remediation_autonomy" {
  value = data.ankra_ai_remediation_policy.this.enabled ? data.ankra_ai_remediation_policy.this.autonomy_level : "off"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `approver_user_ids` (List of String) Users who may approve actions.
- `autonomy_level` (String) `read_only`, `propose` or `auto`.
- `cluster_allow_list` (List of String) Clusters remediation is limited to; null means every cluster.
- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Minutes between actions on the same incident.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether AI remediation is on.
- `id` (String) Always `ai_remediation_policy`.
- `max_actions_per_incident` (Number) Most actions taken for one incident.
- `slack_webhook_id` (String) Slack destination approvals are asked in, if any.
- `tier_overrides` (Map of String) Per action tier: `auto`, `approval` or `never`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the policy last changed; null for the default.
